name: Stormwreck Isle
description: A small island on the Sword Coast with a foreboding name. Seaweed shimmers in brilliant colors; rays of sunlight illuminate lush grass and dark basalt rock. Calm harbor on the north side. Shaped by centuries of dragon conflict and draconic magic.
itemsOfInterest: Draconic spiritual scars where dragons died
notes: Adventure for levels 1–3. Red dragon Sharruth imprisoned beneath the sea — her fury shaped the volcanoes here.
